structuredContent.answer: Substantially below the Healthy People 2030 target of 95.0%. Idaho: 75.2% (CDC SchoolVaxView, 2024–25 school year). CDC associates coverage below ~95% with increased outbreak risk. Over the 9y window: fell from 89.9 to 75.2% of kindergartners, a -14.7 percentage point change.
caveats: NIS measures coverage in toddlers; SchoolVaxView measures coverage at kindergarten entry. Estimates may differ for the same birth cohort.
